column5: format
tile n at +16n: 2 byte columns x 8 lines, column-major; objects row-major 2 x 12 at (CPC offset)/2
column6: tiles 01-0A opaque copy; 0B-7F pen 2 (11) transparent; 80-D9 pen 1 (10) transparent; objects pen 0 (01) transparent (sprite merge), opaque in the score bar
column8: tape image 8300h-9E3Fh = tile n at 8300h + 32n (after start-up tiles 00-7F live in the screen gaps C6xx-FFxx); slots 00 73 85 86 unused (6D unused by the rooms); objects in 2D-2F, A1-A6

column5: row-major, ceil(w/2) bytes a line, odd w: low nibble of the last byte = padding 01
column8: 4 sub-blocks (Guillermo 5x174, 4x33, Adso 5x95, 4x90); AA2Dh-AA48h unused; rule aislado, Adso w4 sim; hand retouches c64/datos/retoques64.txt

column5: row-major, 3 bytes x 40 lines
row-major, 1 byte x 8 lines each (V, I)
column8: the blank glyph row 50D7h (FF FF) = 1 byte 00

column5: row-major, 3 bytes a line (w 5)
column7: mirrored at draw time (bit 14 of the robe pointer)
column8: 6 robes of 26, 24, 24, 25, 23, 23 lines; 2126h copies them to AE2Eh and flips the copy (dead: overwritten by the height buffer, B06E-B102 never read)

column5: row-major, 3 bytes a line; 7 x (2 faces x 10 lines)
4 bytes a glyph (2Dh-5Ah): rows 2k / 2k+1 in the high / low nibble, bit 3 = left pixel
column6: drawn opaque: set pixel pen 3 (00) on pen 2 (11); inverted = EOR FFh
column8: rule der, N redrawn, ';' from the left pixels

column5: as the font

column8: rule izq; CPC sources C600h, D600h, E600h, F600h (512 bytes each, hidden rows of the tape image); goes straight into the bitmap

column5: as on the CPC: 15 big-endian words, one bit per CPC byte = per C64 nibble (0 = dark)
column6: writes dark (pen 3 = 00) nibbles into the sprite buffer

column5: 4 nibbles (low 4 bits): the partial nibble of the bar for obsequium & 3
column8: full nibble pen 2 = F, empty pen 3 = 0 (CPC 0Fh, FFh)
